why: The baseline the whole receipt is read against. Every `concept` instance in this corpus is reachable and nothing bounds the pack, so `written` is all four, `omitted` and `elided` are zero, and `omitted_by_class` is empty. A server that cannot produce this cannot be trusted on the budgeted case, where the same fields are the only evidence a caller has about what it is NOT holding. `budget.tokens` is null rather than absent — the present-and-null discipline `origin` and `degraded_reason` already follow — so a client testing the key never has to distinguish `unbudgeted` from `a server too old to say`.
